title: Woman with Two Bears
description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman with long, swirling magenta and orange hair adorned with spirals, holding an orange poppy flower. She is accompanied by two stylized teddy bears with intricate colorful patterns, blue starry eyes, and purple snouts, nestled against a swirling green and yellow background with floating floral elements.
